description: Release gates every skill must meet (SPEC-104). A skill's success-criteria file replaces a gate here by id, or else by metric, keeping its optionality; other gates in that file are added as mandatory. A gate that did not run never passes; optional_when_unavailable gates are skipped, with their reason, only when their metric could not be measured in this environment.

gates.rationale: No validator error and at most two warnings or description weaknesses (SPEC-104 rubric).
Every unit test of the skill passes (CONVENTIONS section 9.3); a skill without tests cannot pass.
Scripts are deterministic, so any failing deterministic case is a bug (CONVENTIONS section 9.4).
Every script envelope and payload validates against its contract.
The model, guided by the skill, returns contract-valid JSON (Ollama Cloud has no structured outputs).
gates.optional_reason: agentic cases need a reachable model runtime (Ollama local or cloud, Claude Code or Codex)

gates.rationale: Small local models follow the procedure in most runs; failures count, skips never do.
gates.optional_reason: agentic cases need a reachable model runtime and, when they have judgments, Jev

gates.rationale: Requests for this skill route to it, and neighbouring requests do not.
gates.optional_reason: routing needs Jev or a reachable model runtime

gates.rationale: At most one judgment in ten lands in the uncertain band that needs a human.
gates.optional_reason: judgments need Jev (TYPESAFE_API_KEY or JEV_API_KEY and network access)
